scripts.check: vp fmt --check && vp run -r check && pnpm lint
scripts.fix: vp fmt && vp run -r check --fix && markdownlint-cli2 --fix && textlint --fix '**/*.md'
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:md && pnpm lint:text && pnpm lint:spell && pnpm lint:secret && pnpm lint:actions
scripts.lint:actions:security: sh -c 'if command -v zizmor >/dev/null; then zizmor .github/workflows; elif [ -n "$LINT_ACTIONS_REQUIRED" ]; then echo "zizmor is not installed"; exit 1; else echo "zizmor is not installed (pipx install zizmor); the Lint workflow runs it"; fi'
